# EnVERT Group

> A multidisciplinary engineering, advisory, design, consultancy and publishing group of companies working across twelve markets. Headquartered in Kolkata, West Bengal, India.

EnVERT Group delivers integrated engineering, industrial sustainability, mobility, global conferences, and knowledge publishing solutions across India and international markets.

## Operating Divisions & Practice Categories
- [Clean Energy & Industrial Efficiency](https://www.envertgroup.com/businesses/energy): Turnkey solar PV, biomass CHP, and statutory Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) industrial audits operated by NRG India (Nandi Resources Generation Technology Pvt. Ltd.).
- [Electric Mobility](https://www.envertgroup.com/businesses/transport-electric): High-efficiency electric 3-wheelers, light commercial EV platforms, and powertrain systems engineered by EnVERT E-Vehicles Private Limited.
- [Sustainable Tourism & Industry Platforms](https://www.envertgroup.com/businesses/icst): International Conference on Sustainable Tourism and global hospitality exchange organized by ICST Global.
- [Corporate Training & Relocation](https://www.envertgroup.com/businesses/corporate-training): Technical workforce training, executive leadership programs, and turnkey corporate mobility via India Corporate Trainers.
- [Specialty Chemicals & Epoxy Solutions](https://www.envertgroup.com/businesses/repoxisy): Heavy-duty industrial floor coatings, protective primers, and anti-corrosive chemical formulations by REPOXISY.
- [Solar Rail & Green Sanitation](https://www.envertgroup.com/businesses/wagsol): Patented solar train roof arrays, biotoilet bacterial culture, and railway electrical systems by WAGSOL.
- [Periodical Journalism & Publishing](https://www.envertgroup.com/businesses/publication): International travel periodicals, investigative reporting, children's literature, and academic monographs via Pen & Ink Publishers, Touriosity Travelmag, and Glare Post.
- [Policy Research & Technoeconomic Analysis](https://www.envertgroup.com/businesses/research): Industrial energy policy, regulatory advisory, and environmental impact assessments by EIPR.
- [Social Stewardship & Living](https://www.envertgroup.com/businesses/stewardship): Grassroots afforestation drives, rural literacy campaigns, and community welfare directed by EnVERT Foundation.
